snippet.title: Choice of Kung Fu Video Trailer
snippet.description:
Choice of Kung Fu is an epic interactive fantasy novel where your choices control the story. The game is entirely text-based--without graphics or sound effects--and driven by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.


Become the greatest fighter the world has ever known, harnessing the power of chi to manipulate the energies of the universe.

Defeat rivals, find romance, and rise to become the Imperial Champion.

Will you play as male or female? Gay or straight? Will you battle against foreign invaders, or will you rise up against the Emperor?

The fate of the Middle Kingdom depends on you!
